profile.headline: Software Engineer | Computer Science, Engineering
profile.summary: Software Engineer with a passion for building software. I’ve worked on maintaining and modernizing legacy systems as well as developing APIs and backend infrastructure that bring value to the business. I am an avid learner who thrives on a consistent stream of new found knowledge, breaking down complex problems, and collaborating with others to create impactful solutions.

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
• Led the implementation of MongoDB database schemas, indexes, and schema validation scripts for my team, providing well-documented, organized, and maintainable collections

• Co-led the backend development of a feature for a modern logistics pipeline by creating a network of several Spring API's and Kafka producers/consumers

• Leveraged Azure DevOps and the open source build system Nx to manage monorepositories and
automate the build, test, and deployment lifecycle of highly scalable microservices

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
• Provided direction and contributed to the architectural design of a modernized logistics pipeline for providing customers with accurate rates for loads by leveraging expertise in complex and ambiguous business logic

• Implemented an entire feature for a .NET Framework desktop application that allowed managers of internal business unit to standardize excel column headers for customer excel file import and export documents

• Contributed to the development of an Angular UI prototype aimed to move users from a legacy C# application utilizing .NET Framework, WinForms & Infragistics as the UI library

• Created and maintained RESTful services in ASP.NET Core utilizing MVC architecture, LINQ, Entity Framework, and SQL Server as the persistence layer

• Utilized Kafka in conjunction with RESTful Spring API's

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Maintained and iterated upon a long standing C# desktop application serving hundreds of internal users

• Handled on-call rotations by assisting users with urgent issues, monitoring production jobs, and resolving high-priority bugs that consistently improved application performance and user satisfaction

• Led monthly user assisted testing and release cycles to ensure deployed features work appropriately in
production

• Debugged and optimized complex SQL queries using SSMS

• Worked with SOAP web services
